text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What is this... This stinging, tense 
presence—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Is it coming from... the statue of the 
Three Goddesses?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What is this... What's going on...?
